integrity: Analytic repeated-block spectrum and ordering proof, with a finite numerical supplement. The collision leading constants are credited to the earlier symmetric triple-cluster theorem.
scientific_limitations: Uniformly weighted critical Fourier interpolation on a symmetric three-periodic sampling pattern, with consecutive frequencies and sizes divisible by three; no assertion for arbitrary node perturbations.
title: Exact singular bands and a quarter-grid crossing in three-periodic Fourier interpolation
